integrity: The new claim is the rank-deficient uniqueness theorem together with the exact minimum product length \(n+1\). The proof is analytic; finite calculations in the verifier are supplementary checks only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the interior family \(0<s<1\) with only the Dicke levels \(k=0\) and \(k=1\).
It proves uniqueness of the closest separable density operator and minimum product-decomposition length \(n+1\), but not uniqueness of the minimizing ensemble.
The known relative-entropy value and existence of a phase-twirled optimizer are credited to prior work and are not claimed as new.
title: Uniqueness and minimal product length of the closest separable state on the one-zero Dicke edge
